import pandas as pd
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

folder = "abfss://apmt-elz@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/moves_xlsx/"

files = [f for f in mssparkutils.fs.ls(folder)
         if not f.isDir and f.name.lower().endswith((".csv", ".xlsx"))]
print(f"{len(files)} file(s):", [f.name for f in files])

def read_one(f):
    local = f"/tmp/{f.name}"
    mssparkutils.fs.cp(f.path, f"file:{local}")
    if f.name.lower().endswith(".csv"):
        raw = pd.read_csv(local, header=None, dtype=str, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    else:
        raw = pd.read_excel(local, header=None, dtype=str)
    # header row = first row whose first cell is "Time Completed" (works with or without the logo/title rows)
    hdr = raw.index[raw.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == "Time Completed"][0]
    pdf = raw.iloc[hdr + 1:].copy()
    pdf.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in raw.iloc[hdr]]
    pdf = pdf.loc[:, [c for c in pdf.columns if c and c != "nan"]].dropna(how="all")
    # normalise timestamps per file (Excel date cells vs "15-Oct-2026 00:01" text)
    ts = pd.to_datetime(pdf["Time Completed"], errors="coerce", dayfirst=True)
    pdf["Time Completed"] = ts.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    pdf["source_file"] = f.name
    return pdf

pdf_all = pd.concat([read_one(f) for f in files], ignore_index=True)
pdf_all.columns = [c.replace(".", "_").replace(" ", "_") for c in pdf_all.columns]
pdf_all = pdf_all.astype(object).where(pdf_all.notna(), None)

schema = ", ".join(f"`{c}` string" for c in pdf_all.columns)
df = spark.createDataFrame(pdf_all, schema=schema)

df = (df.withColumn("Time_Completed", F.to_timestamp("Time_Completed"))
        .withColumn("Dist_Carry", F.col("Dist_Carry").cast("double").cast("int"))
        .withColumn("Dist_Start", F.col("Dist_Start").cast("double").cast("int")))

# drop rows duplicated across overlapping exports
# before = df.count()
# df = df.dropDuplicates([c for c in df.columns if c != "source_file"]).cache()
# after = df.count()
key_cols = ["Unit_Nbr", "Time_Completed", "Event_ID", "From_Position", "To_Position"]

df = df.withColumn(
    "move_key",
    F.sha2(F.concat_ws("||", *[F.coalesce(F.col(c).cast("string"), F.lit("")) for c in key_cols]), 256)
)

before = df.count()
# keep the newest file's copy if an export overlaps
from pyspark.sql import Window
w = Window.partitionBy("move_key").orderBy(F.col("source_file").desc())
df = (df.withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
        .filter("rn = 1").drop("rn")
        .cache())
after = df.count()
print(f"Rows: {before} -> {after} ({before - after} duplicates removed)")


# display(df.groupBy("source_file").count())
# print(f"Rows: {before} -> {after} after removing {before - after} duplicates")
# print("Null timestamps:", df.filter(F.col("Time_Completed").isNull()).count())  # should be 0
df.printSchema()
display(df.limit(20))

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

d = F.to_date("Time_Completed")
isodow = ((F.dayofweek(d) + 5) % 7) + 1
iso_year = F.year(F.date_add(d, 4 - isodow))

INF_LIMIT = 10000
is_inf  = F.col("Dist_Carry") >= INF_LIMIT
is_zero = F.col("Dist_Carry") == 0

summary = (
    df.withColumn("Move_Date", d)
      .withColumn("ISO_Year", iso_year)
      .withColumn("ISO_Week", F.weekofyear("Move_Date"))
      .groupBy("Move_Date", "ISO_Year", "ISO_Week",
               "Unit_Frght_Kind", "Unit_Category", "Move_Kind", "Event_ID")
      .agg(F.sum("Dist_Carry").alias("Total_Dist_Carry"),
           F.count("*").alias("Move_Count"),
           F.sum(F.when(is_inf, 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Infinity_Count"),
           F.sum(F.when(is_inf, F.col("Dist_Carry")).otherwise(0)).alias("Infinity_Sum"),
           F.sum(F.when(is_zero, 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Zero_Count"))
      .withColumn("ISO_Week_Label",
                  F.concat(F.col("ISO_Year"), F.lit("-W"), F.lpad(F.col("ISO_Week").cast("string"), 2, "0")))
      .select("Move_Date", "ISO_Week_Label", "ISO_Year", "ISO_Week",
              "Unit_Frght_Kind", "Unit_Category", "Move_Kind", "Event_ID",
              "Total_Dist_Carry", "Move_Count",
              "Infinity_Count", "Infinity_Sum", "Zero_Count")
      .orderBy("Move_Date", "Unit_Frght_Kind", "Unit_Category", "Move_Kind", "Event_ID")
)

# Checks: each total must match the raw data
print("Summary rows:", summary.count())
print("Total_Dist_Carry:", summary.agg(F.sum("Total_Dist_Carry")).first()[0],
      "| raw:", df.agg(F.sum("Dist_Carry")).first()[0])
print("Infinity_Count:", summary.agg(F.sum("Infinity_Count")).first()[0],
      "| raw:", df.filter(F.col("Dist_Carry") >= INF_LIMIT).count())
print("Zero_Count:", summary.agg(F.sum("Zero_Count")).first()[0],
      "| raw:", df.filter(F.col("Dist_Carry") == 0).count())

display(summary)
